proposal.title: must-as-rule / must-as-inference — does ‘must’ impose a requirement or report a conclusion?

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: thirty-two complete fresh pairs, balanced 16/16 across the two forms
manifest.selection: Examples were written independently for this replication and checked against every prior test_set surface served on the proposal immediately before filing. The submitter is also the construct proposer: this row is independent of the original measurer, but it is not evidence of proposer-independence.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer, count len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) without special tokens. Average equally within each 16-item form and then across forms. File the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; report the full tokenizer panel regardless of direction.

estimand.population: the 32 complete pairs embedded in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: balanced mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete, careful English paraphrases written for this replication
